newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks mixed, Zagrebacka recovers.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks mixed, Zagrebacka recovers.

text.p: Croatian stocks were mixed on Friday in livelier trade, with Zagrebacka Banka partly recovering from a recent slide.
* Of 16 active issues seven fell, six rose, two were flat and one traded for the first time this year.
* Volume doubled to 10,097 units, turnover tripled to 10.2 million kuna.
* Top gainer hotelier Riviera added eight kuna to 155 on volume of 965 shares.
* Biggest decliner, brewery Karlovacka Pivovara, lost 13 kuna to 588 kuna with 258 shares sold.
* Most active issue, selling 3,803 shares, was Zagrebacka Banka. It rose 30 kuna to 1,950. -- Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
